Our Programs

A Place to Grow at Every Stage

From tiny infants to school-age explorers, we have a warm, age-appropriate space for every child.

🌱 6 weeks – 12 months

Infant Care

Gentle, attentive care in a calm environment with low ratios so every baby feels safe and deeply loved.

🐾 1 – 2 years

Toddler Room

Playful discovery that builds language, coordination, and confidence — one wondrous step at a time.

🎨 3 – 5 years

Pre-K Program

School-readiness woven into art, music, science, storytelling, and rich cooperative play every day.

🌻 K – 5th grade

After School

A welcoming landing spot after school — homework help, outdoor time, and creative projects.

Life at Little Monkeys

A Peek Inside

Happy children, colorful spaces, and hands-on learning — every single day.

Why Families Choose Us

Care You Can Count On

We believe children thrive when they feel safe, seen, and celebrated every single day.

🍽️

Wholesome Meals Included

CACFP-approved breakfast, lunch, and snacks prepared fresh daily with nourishing ingredients.

Outdoor Time Every Day

Safe fenced play yard with age-appropriate equipment and space for active, nature-led play.

Research-Backed Curriculum

Programs that nurture early literacy, numeracy, and social-emotional growth through joyful learning.

Daily Updates for Parents

Qualified, Caring Educators

🤝

Open-door policy, consistent communication, and monthly family events — we're in this together.
